mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM users u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM users u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND r.status = 1 AND p.status = 1
